title: Bills set to officially unveil $2.1B stadium with national TV game in Week 2 against Lions

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bills set to officially unveil $2.1B stadium with national TV game in Week 2 against Lions
sources.description: Highmark Stadium will officially open its doors as the Bills' new home when they face the Lions on Thursday Night Football in Week 2 on Sept. 17.
